answer_1.quote: Evaluation plays a pivotal role in advancing the research on natural language generation (NLG) . It aims to measure the quality of the generated hypotheses in NLG tasks (e.g., machine translation, text summarization, and image caption)
answer_1.outputs: Generated hypotheses such as translations, summaries, and captions

answer_2.quote: We evaluate a variety of automatic metrics covering different categories. ... Character-based metrics: ChrF; Word-based metrics: BLEU, ROUGE-1/2/L, METEOR, CIDEr, and SPICE; Embedding-based metrics: BERTScore and MoverScore; Trained metrics: BLEURT, Prism, COMET, and BARTScore; LLM-based metrics: GEMBA-Dav3-DA and ChatGPT-eval (Stars w/ ref)

answer_3.quote: LLM-based metrics: GEMBA-Dav3-DA and ChatGPT-eval (Stars w/ ref)

answer_4.quote: Human judgements measure these summaries in terms of coherence, consistency, fluency, and relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluation based on multiple dimensions including coherence, consistency, fluency, and relevance
